flyer.orgLine: CARTHAGE COLLEGE / DEPARTMENT OF COMPUTER SCIENCE
flyer.headline: Summer Student Research / Development Opportunity
flyer.intro: Dr. Jake Pichelmeyer of Carthage's Computer Science Department invites inquiries and applications for collaborative summer research and development. We provide structured opportunities to bridge academic foundations with applied computing engineering.
flyer.inclusiveStatement: We are committed to an inclusive environment. Students of all experience levels and backgrounds are encouraged to apply.
flyer.noDeadlineText: Applications reviewed on a rolling basis

prospect.headline: Future Students: Build Things With Me
prospect.intro: I'm Dr. Jake Pichelmeyer, and I run PLAB, my lab for Autonomy and Bioemulation. At Carthage, undergraduates don't wait for grad school to do real research and development in AI, artificial life, robotics, and games.
why: Small classes, taught directly by your professor.
Paid SURE summer research is open as early as the summer after your first year.
Earn credit for research (CSC 4900) and graduate with a real portfolio.

courseBlurbs.csc1100: Programming from zero in Python. No experience needed.
courseBlurbs.csc1810: Where CS majors start: object-oriented programming in C#.
courseBlurbs.csc2710: Project-based: build games across genres in Godot and Unity.
courseBlurbs.csc3530: Build intelligent programs and learn what they reveal about the mind.
courseBlurbs.csc3730: Pathfinding, behavior trees, and machine learning for games.
courseBlurbs.csc4110: Hands-on lab: sensors, microcontrollers, and networks.

extraCourses.catalog: How AI agents learn by trial, error, and reward.

items.title: SURE summer research
items.text: Carthage's Summer Undergraduate Research Experience: 10 weeks, full-time, with a stipend, campus housing, and a meal plan, open to first- through third-year students. One SURE position is guaranteed for Summer 2027 with me as your mentor (I'll choose based on fit, preparation, and availability). Other students can apply through the SURE committee, but that funding isn't guaranteed. Applications are due in March.
items.short: 10 weeks, full-time; stipend, housing, meals. First- through third-year students. One spot guaranteed for Summer 2027; others may apply via the SURE committee (due in March).

items.title: Course credit
items.text: Research can count toward CSC 4900, Research in Computer Science (1-4 credits). It requires CSC 1820 with a C- or higher, and my approval.
items.short: CSC 4900 Research in CS, 1-4 credits (needs CSC 1820 and instructor approval).
